blocks.text: Icons can easily be added to your HTML page, by using an icon library.

Just add the name of the icon class to any inline HTML element
(like <i> or <span>).
Icons from icon libraries are scalable vectors that can be customized with CSS (size, color, shadow, etc.).

To use the Font Awesome icons, go to
fontawesome.com, sign in, and get a code to add in the <head> section of your HTML page.
